verdict.rationale: GitHub releases and a Homebrew-based install script indicate prebuilt binaries/packages exist for the CLI (rcli/wally), avoiding a from-source build (runanywhere-comm-4, runanywhere-comm-9, runanywhere-probe-3). However, hands-on reports directly contradict reliable prebuilt installation: a segmentation fault right after install, a report that installed binaries don't load everything properly, and a user stating 'this doesn't work on any of the methods I've tried' (runanywhere-comm-3, runanywhere-comm-4, runanywhere-comm-14). Missing for 10: official docs describing a documented package-manager/binary install flow (e.g. brew formula, apt/npm package) with success confirmation, and independent corroboration that prebuilt installs work reliably across platforms.
